column1: # GitOps chart name -> public source used to build the pre-bootstrap bundle.
# Application repoURLs deliberately point to the in-cluster Gitea Helm registry so
# ArgoCD refresh/resync/selfHeal remain offline after bootstrap. That registry does
# not exist while this script builds the bundle, so never derive its public source
# from an Application's repoURL. Add or update the source here instead.
# NOT GUESSED. Every helm-repo row was verified with `helm repo add` plus `helm
# search repo <alias>/<chart> --versions`; the git row was verified by checking out
# the pinned tag, confirming its commit, and packaging its chart path with Helm.
# source-type is helm-repo or git. A git row requires all three trailing fields;
